name: Rot Hulk

abilities.text: When ~ enters, return up to X target Zombie cards from your graveyard to the battlefield, where X is the number of opponents you have.

notes: return-from-graveyard takes a numeric count only, so the X (the number of opponents you have) is written as a move of a chosen set from your graveyard: you pick up to that many Zombie cards. That form chooses on resolution instead of targeting on the stack (CR 115.1), which is the one deviation.

issues: return UP TO X target Zombie cards from your graveyard to the battlefield — expected 'up to' — you may choose fewer targets, including zero — scripted move with what.count={count:'opponents'} and no optional flag; chooseFrom (game.ts:1761-1779) asks with exact:true and returns ALL candidates outright when n >= cands.length, so the return is mandatory at exactly min(X, available). — CR 601.2c, 115.1

return up to X TARGET Zombie cards — expected targets chosen when the trigger goes on the stack and re-checked for legality on resolution — scripted chosen on resolution via chooseFrom (script notes admit this), so nothing is targeted — hexproof/shroud-from-graveyard style effects, 'can't be the target of', and target-count checks never apply. — CR 115.1, 603.3d

Zombie cards — expected any card with the Zombie subtype in your graveyard, including a Kindred/Tribal noncreature Zombie card — scripted filter {types:['Creature'], subtypes:['Zombie']} — narrowed to Zombie CREATURE cards; the render confirms 'Zombie creature cards'. — CR 205.3m

return UP TO X target Zombie cards from your graveyard to the battlefield — expected You may choose fewer than X, including zero. — scripted move with what.count={count:'opponents'} and no optional flag; chooseFrom (game.ts:1761-1779) returns ALL candidates outright when n >= cands.length and otherwise asks with exact:true — the return is mandatory 'exactly min(X, available)'. The notes disclose the targeting deviation but not the loss of 'up to', and there is no needs/ignore entry. — CR CR 601.2c, 115.1

up to X TARGET Zombie cards — expected Targets chosen when the trigger goes on the stack; legality rechecked on resolution. — scripted chooseFrom picks on resolution, so nothing is targeted: shroud/hexproof-style protection, 'can't be the target', and target-count effects never apply. — CR CR 115.1, 603.3d

Zombie cards — expected Any card with the Zombie subtype in your graveyard (a Kindred/Tribal Zombie noncreature card qualifies). — scripted filter {types:['Creature'], subtypes:['Zombie']} — narrowed to Zombie CREATURE cards; render confirms 'Zombie creature cards'. — CR CR 205.3m
